title: The Harbor of Port Alder
author: Lior Voss
blurb: Juniper Brightwater, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, has spent fifteen years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
